}}'''Amellia Arene''', along with her husband, [[Jorin Arene]], is a merchant in [[Amador]].{{ref|{{twotc}}, Amellia Arene}} She and her husband are both [[Darkfriends]].

==Appearance==
She has a stern face, and graying hair.

==Activities==
[[Liandrin]] and [[Liandrin's Group of Black Sisters|her group]] take over Amellia Arene's house in Amador. [[Temaile Kinderode]] caused serious harm to Amellia's husband. Amellia begged Liandrin to [[Heal]] Jorin.{{ref/book|5|18}} About a month later, [[Moghedien]] gives Amellia and [[Evon]], the house cook, a shielded Liandrin to use as a scullery girl.{{ref/book|5|34}}
